# Tauri effect references

These 12 raw RGBA fixtures were generated by compiling and invoking the actual
`E:/PixPin/core/core-algo/src/draw.rs` functions `smart_erase_region` and
`spotlight_region`, not by copying the Dart implementation's outputs.

Source SHA-256: `8fdf0442d5222990f36c6ca50ba6d6a167d25d174f63b242d3dbd85efa7ff287`.
Generated 2026-10-31. Original algorithm source is MIT licensed.

Each file is 12 × 10 × 4 bytes, row-major RGBA. The input image is generated in
`tauri_effect_parity_test.dart`. Cases cover an interior rectangle, negative
coordinates, a screen edge, the entire image, a rectangle outside the image,
and a one-pixel-wide rectangle. Smart erase starts with an opaque red region
painted over the base. Spotlight uses the untouched base, radius 3, dim 150.

Smart erase comparisons require byte-for-byte equality. Spotlight permits
one RGB level of rounding difference because Rust uses f32 and Dart uses f64;
alpha must match exactly. These fixtures add no Rust dependency to the app.
